title: 第19章 阵盘入手第20章 实力是最好的通行证
lines: 锦袍中年目光一凝，仔细感知后，脸上首次露出了动容之色：
“是清灵泉！
而且品质竟然如此纯净！”
他看向姜望的眼神顿时不同了，带着审视与探究：
“阁下能随手拿出此等品质的清灵泉，莫非是……发现了一处泉眼？”
姜望面色不变，淡然道：
“我是来做交易的，不是来回答问题的，阁下若有意，便谈交易，若无兴趣，多说无益。”
语气虽平淡，却带着一股不容置疑的底气。
锦袍中年闻言，非但不恼，反而哈哈一笑，抱拳道：
“是在下唐突了，鄙人姓赵，单名一个琰字，是枫叶城万宝斋在此地的管事，阁下如何称呼？”
姜望惜字如金。
“原来是姜公子。”
赵琰也不纠结，笑眯眯地说道，态度明显热络了许多：
“姜公子既然手握灵泉这等资源，想必所需之物也非比寻常，请随我来看看我们的货品！”
他引着姜望来到一片陈列区，这里的东西明显比外面高了一个档次
姜望目光扫过，发现里面确实有些不错的货色。
几柄寒光闪闪，隐隐有灵气波动的长剑和匕首，几件内衬软甲，看似坚韧的皮甲，全都属于“半灵器”
范畴。
对练气期修士或许鸡肋，但对目前的玩家来说，无疑是神兵利器。
“这些都是我们万宝斋的炼器大师精心打造，掺入了少许灵铁，妖兽筋皮，锋利无比，坚韧非凡，远超凡俗铁器可比……”
赵琰介绍说道，话语间不免有夸大吹嘘成分。
姜望不动声色地听着，偶尔拿起一件掂量一下，神识微探，便知底细。
随后便是打断了赵琰的吹嘘，直接开始讨价还价。
双方围绕着一件件半灵器的价格，以“瓶”
为计量单位的清灵泉，展开了激烈的拉锯战。
赵琰极力想多换些灵泉，姜望则寸土不让。
“姜公子，你这价杀得也太狠了。”
赵琰突然提议道：“这样，若是姜公子愿意长期供应灵泉交易，价格我们可以再商量，而且我们万宝斋总部的好东西远不止这些，之后还会不定时补充新货。”
赵琰见姜望能一次拿出这么多的清灵泉，已经笃定姜望必然掌握着一处稳定的清灵泉资源。
姜望心中一动，获取稳定资源的渠道途径，自然多多益善，便顺势应下。
最终，姜望用六瓶清灵泉，换取了三把质地不错的半灵器长剑，两把匕首以及三件轻便的皮甲。
这个价格，姜望算是占了便宜，但赵琰想着长远合作，自然做出了让步。
“姜公子爽快！”
赵琰微笑着完成了交易，然后状似无意地问道：
“公子看看，可还有什么感兴趣之物？”
姜望心中一动，知道时机到了。
他从过来之前，神识就已经锁定到了角落处。
一个打开的木箱中，随意堆放着的五面巴掌大小，色泽暗淡，布满灰尘的三角小旗和一个中心有凹槽的圆盘。
它们灵气全无，如同凡铁废木，但在姜望的感知下，却能察觉到其内部残留的极其微弱的阵法符文波动。
正是他苦苦寻找的，聚灵阵的阵旗和阵盘！
content_en:
The middle-aged man in brocade robes focused his gaze, and after careful perception, a look of emotion appeared on his face for the first time:
"It's Qingling Spring!
And the quality is so pure! "
The way he looked at Jiang Wang suddenly changed, with scrutiny and inquiry:
"Your Excellency can easily take out a Qingling Spring of this quality. Could it be that... you have discovered a spring?"
Jiang Wang's expression remained unchanged and he said calmly:
"I'm here to make a deal, not to answer questions. If you're interested, let's talk about the deal. If you're not interested, it's useless to talk more."
Although his tone was calm, it carried an unquestionable confidence.
When the middle-aged man in Jinpao heard this, instead of being annoyed, he laughed, clasped his fists and said:
"I'm being rude. My surname is Zhao, and my last name is Yan. I am the steward of Wanbaozhai in Maple Leaf City. What do you call me?"
"Ginger."
Jiang Wangxi's words are like gold.
"It turns out to be Young Master Jiang."
Zhao Yan didn't hesitate and said with a smile, his attitude was obviously much warmer:
"Since Young Master Jiang has resources like the Spiritual Spring in his hands, he must need extraordinary things. Please come with me to see our goods!"
He led Jiang Wang to a display area. The things here were obviously a higher level than outside.
Jiang Wang glanced over and found that there were indeed some good items inside.
Several long swords and daggers with cold light and faint aura fluctuations, and several pieces of soft-lined, seemingly tough leather armor, all of which are "semi-spiritual weapons."
category.
It may be useless to monks in the Qi training stage, but for current players, it is undoubtedly a magic weapon.
"These are carefully crafted by our Wanbaozhai's master craftsmen. They are mixed with a little spiritual iron and monster beast tendons. They are extremely sharp and tough, far beyond the comparison of ordinary iron tools..."
Zhao Yan introduced it, and there was an element of exaggeration in his words.
Jiang Wang listened calmly, occasionally picking up an item to weigh it, and with a little exploration of his consciousness, he knew the details.
Then he interrupted Zhao Yan's bragging and started bargaining directly.
The two sides revolved around the price of each and every semi-spiritual weapon, and the price of the "bottle"
A fierce tug-of-war started over Qinglingquan, the unit of measurement.
Zhao Yan tried his best to exchange for more spiritual springs, but Jiang Wang refused to give up any ground.
"Mr. Jiang, your price is too harsh."
Zhao Yan suddenly suggested: "In this way, if Mr. Jiang is willing to supply Lingquan for a long time, we can discuss the price. Moreover, the good things at our Wanbaozhai headquarters are far more than these, and we will replenish new products from time to time."
Seeing that Jiang Wang could produce so much Qingling Spring at one time, Zhao Yan was certain that Jiang Wang must have a stable Qingling Spring resource.
Jiang Wang thought. The more channels and means to obtain stable resources, the better. So he took advantage of the situation.
In the end, Jiang Wang exchanged six bottles of Qingling Spring for three semi-spiritual swords of good quality, two daggers and three lightweight leather armors.
At this price, Jiang Wang took advantage, but Zhao Yan naturally made concessions because he thought about long-term cooperation.
"Young Master Jiang is so happy!"
Zhao Yan completed the transaction with a smile, and then asked seemingly unintentionally:
"Take a look, sir, is there anything else you're interested in?"
Jiang Wang's heart moved and he knew the time had come.
Before he came over, his consciousness had already been locked in the corner.
In an open wooden box, there were randomly stacked five palm-sized, dim, dusty triangular flags and a disc with a groove in the center.
They have no aura, just like iron and scrap wood, but under Jiang Wang's perception, he can detect the extremely weak fluctuations of formation runes remaining inside them.
It was exactly what he was looking for, the flag and disk of the Spirit Gathering Formation!
